verification.runtimeIntegrationTest: Not run: runtime registration is outside this task's authorization.

integration.registration: Expose SourceWindDevices UMD dependency, compile/create its state, add supportedTypes, call beforeStep and afterStep, and register body solids plus volumes. No existing file modified.
integration.contacts: afterStep accepts windContacts [{windId,actorId}] in collision dispatch order; derive them using the host collision masks and native-equivalent actor collision shapes. Module does not guess masks or player boxes.
integration.forces: beforeStep returns prior contact forces [{actorId,windId,xRaw,yRaw,x,y,mode:'movementVelocityOffset'}]; host applies once to computed movement velocity, then consumes. Units are native pixels/tick, not pixels/second. Overlapping winds use final assignment, never sum.
integration.events: Named or by-type77 events60/61 set weak/strong. Host retains responsibility for generic ActorComponent events.
